newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Olympia profit unaffected by gaming loss.
newsitem.headline: Olympia profit unaffected by gaming loss.

text.p: Olympia Industries Bhd said on Thursday it expects to maintain its profit level for the current year despite the loss of contribution from gaming activities in eastern Sabah state.
Olympia group managing director Yap Yong Seong said contributions from construction, property and stockbroking will make up for the loss in gaming profits.

"Olympia's lottery operations is only one of its activities... apart from that the other units are doing well," he told reporters after the company's annual and extraordinary meetings. He estimated that gaming contributed about 15 to 20 percent of company profits last year.
Olympia reported a 35 percent decline in net earnings for the year ended June 30, 1996 to 44.78 million ringgit, which it said was partially due to the loss of the gaming licence.
Olympia, which is 54.7 percent owned by Mycom Bhd, had the gaming licence of its subsidiary in Sabah state revoked by the Ministry of Finance in January this year.
The company has appealed against the decision.
"We have appealed and we are still awaiting a reply," Yap said. He said there was no indication when it would get a reply.
Yap said the government did not say why the licence of the subsidiary, Lotteries Corp Sdn Bhd, was revoked.
